data.title: Super Strategy Math Lab!
data.description: Discover fun tricks like counting on, doubles, and making ten to solve addition problems within 10 like a math superhero.

challenges.instruction: Someone already solved this addition problem. Which strategy did they use?
challenges.workedSolution: I drew one straight line for the first number, and then I drew nine straight lines right next to it. Finally, I counted all of the lines together to get the total of ten.

challenges.instruction: Someone already solved this addition problem. Which strategy did they use?
challenges.workedSolution: I took 1 away from the 5 and gave it to the 4 to make a 10. Then, I just added the remaining 4 to get 9.

challenges.instruction: Someone already solved this addition problem. Look at their steps. Which strategy did they use?
challenges.workedSolution: I know that 5 plus 5 makes 10 because both numbers are the exact same size. Since I already memorized that fact, I wrote down 10 right away.

challenges.instruction: Someone already solved this subtraction problem. Which strategy did they use?
challenges.workedSolution: I started at 10 and hopped backward 8 times on the number line. As I went down, I landed on 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, and finally 2.
